title: Creating full and empty lists
description: You can compare two lists created with square brackets.

steps.description: snacks holds three strings separated by commas. You place the elements inside square brackets.
Printing snacks displays pretzels, apples and popcorn in their stored order. The output keeps the surrounding brackets.

steps.question: What will printing empty_cart show?
steps.answer: It shows [], because this list contains zero elements.

steps.description: You see [] after the snack list. The same bracket syntax creates a list with elements or an empty one.
